description: Fetches activity report for a specific airport by name, IATA code, or ICAO code over a configurable lookback period (default 24h, max 30 days). Returns traffic summary, activity breakdown (arriving/departing/taxiing/overflight), hourly traffic profile, top flights, origin countries, emergency squawks, and recent positions. Use when the user asks about activity at a specific airport or wants an airport traffic report.
